basics.name: Dr Tom Julian
basics.label: Ophthalmologist and Clinical Academic
basics.summary: I am an ophthalmologist and clinical academic working across image phenotyping, artificial intelligence, genetics, and multi-omics. My research investigates what ophthalmic images can reveal about eye disease and systemic health, and how those insights can be translated into clinically useful tools.

work.name: Oculomex
work.summary: Contributing clinical perspective to the development and evaluation of AI-enabled approaches to assessing systemic health through ophthalmic imaging.

work.name: University of Manchester
work.summary: PhD research combining deep learning-derived ophthalmic image phenotypes with genetic, metabolomic, and other omics datasets to investigate eye and systemic health.

work.name: Manchester Royal Eye Hospital and University of Manchester
work.position: Ophthalmology Resident and Academic Clinical Fellow
work.summary: Clinical ophthalmology alongside clinically grounded research in medical image analysis, genetics, and causal inference.

work.name: Northern General Hospital, Sheffield Teaching Hospitals
work.summary: Combined early postgraduate clinical training with academic work in translational neuroscience and clinical research.
